_comment: One or more upstream sources to sync. Each source is cloned by the workflow via `git clone --sparse` into upstream_checkout_root/<repo_name>/<directory_name>/ BEFORE this script runs. Every output file — both the cleaned JSON under local_output_root and its compiled SRS under SRS/ — is namespaced the same way: <repo_name>/<directory_name>/... This keeps multiple sources from colliding and keeps the SRS tree's top-level naming identical to the synced-file tree's.
_sources_note: Add more entries to 'sources' to sync additional repos/directories — e.g. a second entry with repo_name 'sing-geosite', owner 'SagerNet', repo 'sing-geosite', branch 'rule-set', upstream_path 'geosite', directory_name 'geosite'. Each source's files land under its own repo_name/directory_name namespace in both local_output_root and SRS/, so nothing overwrites another source's files even if filenames match.
_cdn_note: cdn_owner/cdn_repo (used only as a fallback if GITHUB_REPOSITORY isn't set) identify the repo HOSTING these files for jsDelivr — i.e. this repo, not any upstream source. cdn_ref_mode 'tag' links dated SRS snapshots and JSON to the exact release tag just created this run; the 'latest' SRS catalog always links against cdn_branch regardless of this setting, since its contents change every run.
